query: SELECT id, name, type, origin, aromaticProfile, intensity, idealTemperature, internalNotes FROM tabacs ORDER BY name
command: mysql --batch --raw --column-names --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --host gateway02.us-east-1.prod.aws.tidbcloud.com --port 4000 --user 3ND3mF15qH8onZj.root --database H2pjHHJbH276XmnbNcJhCp --execute SELECT id, name, type, origin, aromaticProfile, intensity, idealTemperature, internalNotes FROM tabacs ORDER BY name

rows.name: Burley
rows.internalNotes: Pyrazines brunes, maltol, guaiacol/cresols, acétyl-pyrroline. Familles: Nécro-géo, Fossiles, Poussière, Tell Halaf, Akrotiri Ash

rows.name: Krumovgrad
rows.internalNotes: β-caryophyllène, α-humulène, pyrazines brunes, guaiène, indoles légers. Familles: Rituels, Civilisations perdues, Encens, Noirs anciens

rows.name: Samsoun
rows.internalNotes: β-caryophyllène, α-humulène, géranyl acétate, farnésène, sesquiterpènes. Familles: Rituels, Kyfi Akhet, Cordoue 950, Kyoto Kumo

rows.name: Virginia Bright
rows.internalNotes: Aldéhydes verts (hexanal), E-2-hexénal, limonène, traces ionones. Familles: Longyear Ice, Aurora Ionique, Glace Liquide, Silence Profond

rows.name: Virginia Deutscher
rows.internalNotes: Maltol/ethyl maltol, furanones, pyrazines caramel, ionones. Familles: Nag Hammadi, Papier ancien

rows.name: Virginia Gold
rows.internalNotes: Lactone C14, ionones, aldéhydes C6–C10, furanones blancs. Familles: Bio-Lab, Lacta Solis

rows.name: Virginia Italia
rows.internalNotes: Furanones fruités, ionones, caroténoïdes dégradés, cuir blond léger. Familles: Malabar Zodiac, Figue & Santal, Umbrian/Mediterra ancien

rows.name: Virginia Orange
rows.internalNotes: Ionones, limonène, citral/citronellal, lactones légères, furanones. Familles: Bio-Lab, Figuier, Lacta Solis
